syntax.syntax_item: answer = inputdlg(prompt, title, dims, defaultAnswer, options)

param_input_item.param_description: Prompt text. Use a character vector, string, or cell array of character vectors for several prompts.

param_output_item.param_description: Cell array of character vectors. Returns an empty 0-by-0 cell array when the dialog is canceled.

description.p: inputdlg displays one input prompt after another and returns the entered text.

example_item.example_item_description: Ask for several values with defaults.
